bl_amber.effect: Flips all Jokers face down and shuffles their positions
bl_amber.name: Amber Acorn

bl_cerulean.effect: Forces a random card to always be selected each hand
bl_cerulean.name: Cerulean Bell

bl_crimson.effect: Debuffs a random Joker each hand
bl_crimson.name: Crimson Heart

bl_eye.effect: Cannot play the same poker hand type twice in a row
bl_eye.name: The Eye

bl_fish.effect: Cards are drawn face down after each played/discarded hand, accumulating
bl_fish.name: The Fish

bl_flint.effect: Halves all base Chips and Mult for played hands
bl_flint.name: The Flint

bl_grim.effect: Decreases the level of the played poker hand by 1 (floor of level 1; permanent for the rest of the run)
bl_grim.name: The Arm

bl_hook.effect: Discards 2 random unplayed cards after every played hand
bl_hook.name: The Hook

bl_house.effect: First hand of the round is dealt face down
bl_house.name: The House

bl_mark.effect: Face cards are dealt face down
bl_mark.name: The Mark

bl_mouth.effect: Only the poker hand type of the first played hand can be played this round
bl_mouth.name: The Mouth

bl_needle.effect: Only 1 hand may be played the entire round (score requirement is 1x base — see Section 16)
bl_needle.name: The Needle

bl_ox.effect: Sets money to $0 when your most-played poker hand is played
bl_ox.name: The Ox

bl_pillar.effect: Cards already played earlier this Ante are debuffed
bl_pillar.name: The Pillar

bl_psychic.effect: Must play exactly 5 cards every hand
bl_psychic.name: The Psychic

bl_serpent.effect: Draw 3 cards after each played/discarded hand, regardless of hand size
bl_serpent.name: The Serpent

bl_verdant.effect: All cards are debuffed until a Joker is sold
bl_verdant.name: Verdant Leaf

bl_wheel.effect: 1 in 7 chance for each card *drawn* (not played) to be dealt face down
bl_wheel.name: The Wheel
